root_cause: PR #3974 accidentally inserted the full recovery workflow into the JavaScript RegExp used to update Base-SHA and writer-lease metadata. The workflow remained partially parseable but same-lineage refresh became fragile and could create metadata/ref races and repeated synchronize events.
prevention: The metadata updater now uses one line-anchored regex per machine-readable field. A regression test asserts the recovery workflow has exactly one workflow header, one jobs block and one replaceOne generator, and forbids embedding the queue-storm marker inside the regex.

evidence.invariant: Same-lineage recovery metadata updates may only replace exact machine-readable lines and must never capture or duplicate YAML workflow content.
